characters.carries: a carnival ticket stub laminated into an official medallion
characters.complication: the real ambassador he's impersonating is about to arrive
characters.look: A large, placid capybara wearing an oversized velvet diplomatic sash over damp brown fur, a tiny striped carnival ticket-booth cap perched between his ears, whiskers dusted white with ledger chalk
characters.name: Undersecretary Bramble
characters.role_drive: keep the timeline from unraveling without admitting he isn't really an ambassador

proposal.idea: A bureaucratic archive stamps the timeline's mistakes into official history, and a capybara masquerading as an ambassador is the fragile hinge holding today together.

locations.art_direction: A vaulted archive of shelving fused from glowing astral ore, humming pale blue; brass punch-card conveyor rails loop overhead; a boxy riveted automaton clerk stamps forms with a hissing piston arm beside stacked capybara-sized filing carts.
locations.best_scene: an artifact from next century starts filling out its own intake form
locations.known_for: filing anachronistic artifacts before they destabilize the timeline
locations.local_rule: no object may be shelved until its arrival paperwork is signed by the object itself, or by its own era
locations.title: The Chronofiling Depot

rewards.best_used_when: an object's timeline paperwork is hopelessly contradictory
rewards.catch: it cannot be un-stamped, so a mistake becomes permanently official
rewards.grants: retroactively legitimizes anything it stamps, regardless of when it's actually from
rewards.look: A palm-sized brass stamp, its handle a coiled ribbon of glowing astral ore, the stamp face carved with an ouroboros biting a filing tab, ore-light leaking faintly from the seams
rewards.name: The Stamp of Unlikely Provenance

rewards.best_used_when: caught somewhere, or somewhen, with no paperwork to explain it
rewards.catch: the more it's used, the more paperwork quietly retroactively appears to catch up with the lie
rewards.grants: talks any clerk, guard, or tribunal into believing you were always supposed to be there
rewards.look: A shadow that falls one exposure-stop darker than the room around it, hat brim tilted just low enough to blur the eyes, a thin curl of cigarette smoke bending into the shape of a question mark
rewards.name: Plausible Deniability

scenarios.setup: In The Filing Office at the End of History, at the Chronofiling Depot, Undersecretary Bramble is dragged into an emergency audit when the depot's automaton clerk starts filing carnival tickets that haven't been sold yet — and one of them is stamped with tomorrow's date.
scenarios.title: The Audit That Shouldn't Remember

proposal.title: The Filing Office at the End of History

vibe.art_direction: A cavernous archive of impossible objects on endless shelves, lit by floating brass lamps on chains, capybara-sized filing carts rolling between towers of paper down aisles that recede past where the light reaches.
vibe.line: Every artifact that shouldn't exist yet gets stamped, shelved, and quietly negotiated with.
vibe.title: The Filing Office at the End of History
